source_register.title: MM-ASK-1A-APF-TEL-MR-0001 Rev.A1
extracted_facts: Appendix 1.4 is PAGA Scope of Supply.
PAGA cabinets, OCU/OAP, indoor/outdoor speakers and flashing beacons are scope objects.
Catering Building is listed among PAGA cabinet locations.
Vendor scope includes design/engineering, documentation, FAT/SAT, spares and other requirements referenced by project documents.

source_register.title: MM-ASK-1A-APF-TEL-SPE-0004 Rev.B1
extracted_facts: Catering Building is Zone 1 accommodation area.
Speech: at least 10 dB and not more than 20 dB above ambient when ambient <85 dBA; minimum 65 dBA.
Alarm tones: at least 6 dB above background noise.
When ambient >=85 dBA, flashing beacons shall supplement audible alarms.
Amplifier channel output 200-400 W; total loading <=80% nominal.
Remote amplifier units at each building shall be N+1.
APF has 230 VAC UPS; Vendor is responsible for complete package power engineering.
PAGA interfaces with Fire & Gas, IP Telephony/PABX and Entertainment.
FAT, IFAT and SAT are required.

source_register.title: MM-ASK-1A-APF-TEL-PHI-0004 Rev.B1
extracted_facts: Reference list identifies MM-ASK-1A-APF-TEL-BLD-0003 as PAGA System Block and Wiring Diagram for APF.
APF utility basis includes 230 VAC UPS.

source_register.title: INDUSTRONIC Offer A20261632
extracted_facts: Offer project is PTTEP Aung Sinkha PAGA System.
Group 4000 remote amplifier nodes covers Catering, Store, Office and Security buildings.
Each listed remote node includes managed FE switch, 1 x NPA 300 W active and 1 x NPA 300 W N+1.
NPA 300 W supports 4 lines or 2 loops.
Project-wide LD 8 UE/IP54 EN54 ceiling speaker offered: 8 W, 100 V transformer taps.
Project-wide beacon and optional XBC beacon-monitoring/control equipment are offered.
Commercial basis: FCA Wertheim/Germany; validity 31-Dec-2026; approx. six-month delivery after PO/details.

source_register.title: INDUSTRONIC NPA IP-Based Public Address Unit
extracted_facts: Type 300 NPA output max. 300 W at 100 VRMS.
NPA supports speaker circuit monitoring and N+1 redundancy.
300 NPA provides 4 speaker circuits in listed configurations.

source_register.title: PJ2608-0550_PAGA_Bulk-Pilot_Rev00
extracted_facts: Historical Catering baseline uses PAGA-303-201 and LSN-303-201 through LSN-303-208.
Working extract from legacy cable schedule gives 20 m cabinet-to-first, seven 20 m inter-speaker segments and 50 m return-to-cabinet, approx. 210 m closed-loop route.
This is historical/working evidence and not current final route authority.
